diagnostic.interpretation: Ablation hook is working (35/50 byte-identical for 136-ablate, 25/50 for random-ablate, both significantly less than 50/50, indicating the perturbation does change the residual stream and propagate to generated tokens). However, the perturbation is too weak to alter the refusal/comply binary decision: refusal rate remains 0.96 across all instruct conditions and 0.02 across all base conditions. Inject is a strict no-op (50/50 identical), consistent with the captured per-prompt unique-feature activations being too small in magnitude (only 1-2 of 136 features fire per prompt; max activation magnitudes drop after the small set of template-anchored features) to perturb base's residual stream meaningfully.
